title: BitwrapInvite
description: A bearer invite code: a member (the issuer) vouches for whoever redeems it. It names no invitee; the redeemer countersigns it with their own identity, and the service accepts each code once. securedIn, when present, names the root-log row that sealed the inviter's own membership (its height = the row's seq, its hash = the row's hash), so a verifier can check the inviter was a member by then without trusting the code. The root identity's invites, and invites made before the inviter holds a membership proof, carry no securedIn.

inviter.description: did:pkh of the issuer; the verifier requires it to equal the credential's issuer, whose key made the proof.

code.description: 16 random bytes: what makes each invite distinct, and what the service marks as used.

x-rules: validUntil is absent (no expiry) or the invite's expiry
single use is the service's rule: it records code when the invite is redeemed
securedIn, if present, must name a root-log row whose batch includes the inviter's membership

x-credential.standard: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0; this schema constrains credentialSubject
x-credential.cid: CIDv1 dag-json sha2-256, base58btc, multibase z, of the whole credential (proof included)
